'''Jennifer Losi''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Losi is an American voice actress, born on February 10. Losi joined the series, voicing {{mas|Lillie}} in [[Pokémon Masters EX]]. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, where she voiced [[Oleana]].
